description: Start a live verification run for a project's analytics property via POST /api/v1/analytics/property/verification (202). The run checks script load and collector endpoint asynchronously; poll analytics_get_verification for the outcome. Never fabricate a pass/fail — report the run's actual status. 429 with retryAt when retried too soon. This starts an async live-site check. Does not use credits.

projectId.description: Numeric project id (convenience shape; do not combine with propertyId).

propertyId.description: Explicit analytics property id (primary target). Pass ALONE — combining with a project reference is rejected. When omitted, pass a project reference instead; that resolves only when the project has exactly one property (409 property_scope_ambiguous otherwise).

name: analytics_verify_property
title: Start analytics snippet verification
